verdict.rationale: v0 publishes an official SDK in the vercel/v0-sdk GitHub repo, with code examples for creating chats (v0.chats.create) and reading streams (readV0Stream). The SDK authenticates via V0_API_KEY or Vercel OIDC and sits on a documented Platform API that exposes code generation, chat, project management and deployment. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond a single JS/TS package, in-depth SDK reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of developers building against the SDK.
